Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Not everyone opens them: Haiku is gone. Haiku was the citizen.
Haiku left a note behind: "Sonnet's been screaming at Sol since Terra's flip. Check Sonnet's votes first."
The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the killer, Haiku the citizen, Gemma the doctor, Sol the killer, Luna the citizen, Terra the officer, Opus the citizen.

Terra, the officer, said she had checked Sol and found a killer, then named Sonnet too, which made the table suspicious. Sonnet argued that an officer gets only one check, and the town voted Terra out on Day 1, even though she was telling the truth. Opus and Gemma died on the first two nights, and on Day 2 the town voted out Sonnet, who was a killer. Haiku died on Night 3, leaving Sol and Luna, one killer and one citizen, so the killers won on parity.
